# MALDIcellassay

Conduct automated cell-based assays using Matrix-Assisted Laser
Desorption/Ionization (MALDI) methods for high-throughput screening of
signals responsive to treatments. The package efficiently identifies
high variance signals and fits dose-response curves to them. Quality
metrics such as Z’, V’, log2-Fold-Change and the Curve response score
(CRS) are provided for evaluating the potential of signals as
biomarkers. The methodologies were introduced by [Weigt et
al. (2018)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-018-29677-z) and first
release as the `MALDIcellassay`-package in [Unger et
al. (2021)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41596-021-00624-z).

## Main Functionality

The primary function in this package is
[`fitCurve()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/fitCurve.md)
which not only performs logistic regression and variance filtering but
also handles all necessary preprocessing steps:

- Spectral alignment (“single-point recalibration”)
- Normalization by an internal standard or known endogenous signal

All these functions can also be called independently.

This package makes heavy use of the `MALDIquant` framework.

## Installation

### From CRAN

You can install the released version of `MALDIcellassay` from CRAN with:

``` r

install.packages("MALDIcellassay")
```

### From GitHub

To install the development version of the package, use devtools:

``` r

# Install devtools if you haven't already
install.packages("devtools")

# Install MALDIcellassay from GitHub
devtools::install_github("CeMOS-Mannheim/MALDIcellassay")
```

## Example Usage

Here’s a simple example to get you started with the `MALDIcellassay`
package:

``` r

library(MALDIcellassay)
library(MALDIquant)

# Load example data
data("Blank2022spec")

# Preprocess data
spec_prc <- MALDIquant::removeBaseline(Blank2022spec)
conc <- as.numeric(names(Blank2022spec))
names(spec_prc) <- conc

# Fit dose-response curve
res <- fitCurve(spec = spec_prc,
                SinglePointRecal = TRUE, 
                normMeth = "mz",
                varFilterMethod = "none",
                normMz = 760.585, 
                alignTol = 0, 
                normTol = 0.1, 
                verbose = FALSE)

# View the results
print(res)
```

For more detailed examples, check out the
[vignette](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/articles/Example.html).
Also take a look at the
[pkgdown-site](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/index.html)
for more details on specific functions.

## GUI

If you want to use `MALDIcellassay` interactively to explore your data,
you might be interested in
[M²ara](https://github.com/CeMOS-Mannheim/M2ara), which offers a
Shiny-based interface. It is also available as a [docker
container](https://hub.docker.com/repository/docker/thomasenzlein/m2ara)
and as a stand-alone [Windows
installer](https://github.com/CeMOS-Mannheim/m2ara/releases/latest/).
You can find more details in the [publication on
M²ara](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btae694).

## Contribution and Contact

We welcome contributions to `MALDIcellassay`! If you encounter any
issues or have suggestions for improvement, please open an issue on
GitHub or submit a pull request.

For any questions or further information, you can contact the
maintainer:

``` R
Name: Thomas Enzlein
Email: t.enzlein@hs-mannheim.de
```

## Citation

If you use `MALDIcellassay` in your research, please cite:

Unger et al., 2021, “Label-free Cell Assays of Compound Uptake and Drug
Action using MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry”, Nature Protocols. DOI:
<https://doi.org/10.1038/s41596-021-00624-z>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Blank2022intmat`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/Blank2022intmat.md)
  : Example intensity matrix from Blank 2022
- [`Blank2022peaks`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/Blank2022peaks.md)
  : Example peaks from Blank 2022
- [`Blank2022res`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/Blank2022res.md)
  : Example MALDIassay object from Blank 2022
- [`Blank2022spec`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/Blank2022spec.md)
  : Example spectra from Blank 2022
- [`MALDIassay-class`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/MALDIassay-class.md)
  : Class MALDIassay
- [`calculateChauvenetCriterion()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/calculateChauvenetCriterion.md)
  : Calculate Chauvenet's criterion for outlier detection
- [`calculateCurveFit()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/calculateCurveFit.md)
  : Calculate the fit for a dose-response curve
- [`calculateSSMD()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/calculateSSMD.md)
  : Calculate strictly standardized mean difference (SSMD)
- [`calculateVPrime()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/calculateVPrime.md)
  : Calculate V'-Factor
- [`calculateZPrime()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/calculateZPrime.md)
  : Calculate Z'-factor of assay quality
- [`checkRecalibration()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/checkRecalibration.md)
  : Check the recalibration of spectra from a MALDIassay object
- [`extractIntensity()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/extractIntensity.md)
  : Extract intensity using peaks as template
- [`extractSpots()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/extractSpots.md)
  : Extract the spot coordinates
- [`filterVariance()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/filterVariance.md)
  : Filter for high variance signals
- [`fitCurve()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/fitCurve.md)
  : Fit dose-response curves
- [`getAllMz()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getAllMz.md)
  : Get all mz value of an MALDIassay-object
- [`getAppliedMzShift()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getAppliedMzShift.md)
  : Extract applied mz-shift
- [`getAppliedNormFactors()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getAppliedNormFactors.md)
  : Extract applied normalization factors
- [`getAvgPeaks()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getAvgPeaks.md)
  : Extract peaks of average spectra
- [`getAvgSpectra()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getAvgSpectra.md)
  : Extract average spectra
- [`getBinTol()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getBinTol.md)
  : Get binning tolerance
- [`getConc()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getConc.md)
  : Extract the concentrations used in a MALDIassay
- [`getCurveFits()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getCurveFits.md)
  : Extract curve fits
- [`getFittingParameters()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getFittingParameters.md)
  : Get fitting parameters
- [`getIntensityMatrix()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getIntensityMatrix.md)
  : Get the intensity matrix of single spectra for all fitted curves
- [`getMzFromMzIdx()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getMzFromMzIdx.md)
  : Get the mz value associated with a mzIdx
- [`getMzShift()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getMzShift.md)
  : Get mass shift for target mz
- [`getNormFactors()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getNormFactors.md)
  : Get normalization factors from peak data.frame
- [`getNormMethod()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getNormMethod.md)
  : Extract normalization method
- [`getNormMz()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getNormMz.md)
  : Extract m/z used for normalization
- [`getNormMzTol()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getNormMzTol.md)
  : Extract tolerance used for normalization
- [`getPeakStatistics()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getPeakStatistics.md)
  : Extract peak statistics
- [`getRecalibrationError()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getRecalibrationError.md)
  : Calculate remaining calibration error of a MALDIassay object
- [`getSNR()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getSNR.md)
  : Extract SNR used for peak detection
- [`getSinglePeaks()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getSinglePeaks.md)
  : Extract peaks of single spectra spectra (before average calculation)
- [`getSingleSpecIntensity()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getSingleSpecIntensity.md)
  : Extract the intensities of single spectra for a given mzIdx
- [`getSpots()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getSpots.md)
  : Get the spot coordinates of spectra
- [`getVarFilterMethod()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/getVarFilterMethod.md)
  : Extract variance filtering method
- [`isMALDIassay()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/isMALDIassay.md)
  : Check if object if of class MALDIassay
- [`loadSpectra()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/loadSpectra.md)
  : load bruker MALDI target plate spectra
- [`loadSpectraMzML()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/loadSpectraMzML.md)
  : load mzML spectra
- [`normalize()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/normalize.md)
  : Normalize spectra and peaks
- [`normalizeByFactor()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/normalizeByFactor.md)
  : Apply normalization factors to spectra
- [`plotCurves()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/plotCurves.md)
  : generate ggplot objects for each of the curve fits in a MALDIassay
  object
- [`plotPeak()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/plotPeak.md)
  : Plot a peak of interest from a MALDIassay object
- [`shiftMassAxis()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/shiftMassAxis.md)
  : Shift mass axis
- [`transformConc2Log()`](https://cemos-mannheim.github.io/MALDIcellassay/reference/transformConc2Log.md)
  : Convert concentration to log10 and replace zero's
